name: Jiajia Food Group Co.,Ltd
summary: Jiajia Food Group Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and marketing of condiments in China. It operates through Soy Sauce, Vegetable Oil, MSG, and Other segments. The company offers light and dark soy sauces, edible vegetable oil, vinegar, chicken essence, oyster sauce, cooking wine, monosodium glutamate, dried noodles, and other flavorings. It exports its products to the United States, Canada, Saudi Arabia, the Philippines, New Zealand, Nepal, and India. Jiajia Food Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Changsha, China.
